species.name: Leopard Gecko
species.notes: Hardy gecko, tolerates moderate temp swings. Deli cup with air holes and damp paper towel. Never let heat pack touch container directly.

species.name: Ball Python
species.notes: Most forgiving of the common shipping species. Cloth reptile bag inside insulated box. Secure bag opening with rubber band. Tolerates brief colder exposure better than most.

species.name: Crested Gecko
species.notes: CRITICAL: Most heat-sensitive common gecko. Do not ship if destination daytime high exceeds 80F. Overheating is a primary cause of DOA. Deli cup with ventilation. Consider shipping overnight during cooler months only.

species.name: Bearded Dragon
species.notes: Hardy desert species, most heat-tolerant on this list. Cloth bag inside well-ventilated box. Juveniles under 4 inches use tighter tolerances — treat as baby category.

species.name: Corn Snake
species.notes: Cold-tolerant species, lowest minimum ship temp on list. Cloth bag, secure opening. Can handle brief exposure to upper 30s but extended cold exposure is dangerous.

species.name: Leopard Gecko (Baby/Juvenile)
species.notes: Tighter tolerances than adults. Hatchlings and juveniles under 10g are especially vulnerable to temperature extremes. Always use 72-hour heat pack if any doubt. Smaller deli cup (8-16oz). Do not ship in extreme weather regardless of heat/cold pack.
